# Partnership Requirements | Synapse Network

* Must comply with Discord's [ToS](<https://discord.com/terms>) and [Community Guidelines](<https://discord.com/guidelines>)
* 20+ real members (non bots)
* No everyone/here ping
* No semi-toxic/toxic
* No NSFW
* Have visible partner channel
## Important notes
* We will not provide any \@everyone or \@here ping
* No edits after partnership is done (We do not change invite link even if it expires)
